data.title: Story Bridge
data.description: Compare characters, settings, events, and big ideas across two illustrated stories.

stories.title: Sharing At The Library
stories.opening: Emma sat down at a big table in the library.
stories.closing: Both children smiled and read books together happily.
stories.mainIdea: Sharing books makes reading fun for everyone.

characters.name: Emma
characters.sentence: Emma wanted to read a big picture book.

stories.title: Sharing In The Classroom
stories.opening: Leo sat down at a small desk in the classroom.
stories.closing: Both children smiled and painted pictures together happily.
stories.mainIdea: Sharing art supplies makes painting fun for everyone.
